description: Pull genotype calls for a germplasm × variant set. Filter to bound cost — at minimum, set `variantSetDbId` or `germplasmDbIds`. The upstream pull is capped by deployment policy; when the pull is truncated, narrow the filters. results[] holds the leading calls up to `loadLimit` and a 24,000-byte budget; when it holds fewer than were collected, every collected call is materialized as a dataframe — read it with brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

callFormat.description: Requested call-encoding format, when the server honors it.

callSetDbIds.description: Restrict to these call sets directly.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. results[] also stops at a 24,000-byte budget, whichever bound comes first, and keeps at least one row when any call was collected. When results[] holds fewer rows than were collected, every collected call lands in a dataframe — query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) for the rest. Upstream pageSize is fixed for genotype calls, so this knob only affects the inline preview here (no spillover capacity tradeoff).

variantSetDbId.description: Scope calls to a single variant set. Strongly recommended. List variant sets with brapi_raw_get({ path: "/variantsets" }) — add params.studyDbId to narrow to one study or genotyping project — and read variantSetDbId from the rows.

variantSetDbIds.description: Alternative: multiple variant sets at once, found the same way.

name: brapi_find_genotype_calls

appliedFilters.description: The body sent to POST /search/calls (variant/germplasm/call-set scope plus pageSize).

callFormatting.description: Genotype-encoding hints echoed by the server.

expandHomozygotes.description: When true, homozygous calls are expanded to both alleles.

unknownString.description: String used for unknown / missing calls (often "." or "N").

cap.description: The effective loadLimit when results[] was cut short; shown is below it when the 24,000-byte inline budget bound first (notice says which).

dataframe.description: Every collected call, staged when results[] holds fewer rows than were collected.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

distributions.description: Value frequency per field across the full collected call set.

callSetName.description: Call set name → count of calls from that set.

variantName.description: Variant name → count of calls for that variant.

variantSetDbId.description: Variant set ID → count of calls from that set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_not_found`: An uncaught BrAPI data request answered HTTP 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: An uncaught BrAPI data request exhausted retries after HTTP 429. `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `no_filters`: No variant set, germplasm, call set, or variant filter was provided. `search_endpoint_disabled`: The active dialect declares POST /search/calls as known-dead on this server. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when the pull stopped early: the deployment pull limit fired (`truncated`), or time for upstream requests ran out before the last page (`warnings` says so). Unlike the filter finders, it ignores the inline cut — shown and cap report that.

notice.description: Why no calls were returned, or which bound cut results[] short and the dataframe holding every collected call.

results.description: Leading collected call rows, up to loadLimit and a 24,000-byte budget, whichever binds first.

callSetDbId.description: FK to the call set (one germplasm × one variant set = one call set).

callSetName.description: Display name of the call set.

values.description: Encoded allele values — interpret using top-level `callFormatting`.

genotype.description: Structured genotype payload (array of allele values plus server-specific fields).

genotypeValue.description: Legacy flat string form of the call (provided by some servers instead of `genotype`).

phaseSet.description: Phase-set identifier linking calls that share a haplotype phase.

variantDbId.description: FK to the variant being called.

variantName.description: Display name / alias of the variant.

variantSetDbId.description: FK to the variant set the call belongs to.

shown.description: Length of results[] when loadLimit or the inline byte budget cut it short of the collected calls.

totalCount.description: Total calls collected across all pages (below the upstream total when `hasMore` is true: the deployment-wide pull limit fired, or the upstream deadline ended the pull).

truncated.description: True when the deployment-wide pull limit was reached and more calls exist upstream. Narrow the filters and re-pull.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (truncation, capability gaps, partial pulls).

title: Brapi Find Genotype Calls
